projects.videoName: How to Use Antigravity Without Spending a Single Penny

shots.title: The $0 Hook: Stop Stacking Paid Subscriptions
shots.script: Paying twenty dollars here and fifty dollars there for AI coding tools? Here is how to run Google Antigravity without spending a single penny.
shots.imagePrompt: Cinematic dark studio desk with glowing subscription receipts dissolving into weightless cyan stardust above a sleek laptop running Antigravity IDE, 8k
shots.videoPrompt: Fast dynamic push-in toward a developer desk as floating paper subscription bills dissolve into weightless glowing cyan particles around a sleek dark-mode laptop

shots.title: Start with the Built-In Free Quota
shots.script: Step one: download Antigravity and sign in with your standard Google account—the built-in free quota gives you frontier models out of the box.
shots.imagePrompt: Close-up over-the-shoulder view of a minimalist dark IDE splash screen with a glowing Free Tier Active badge and zero-dollar counter, crisp macro screen
shots.videoPrompt: Smooth over-the-shoulder dolly shot as the Antigravity workspace launches with a weightless floating animation and a bright green $0.00 Free Quota indicator lights up

shots.title: Switch Routine Tasks to Flash & Flash-Lite
shots.script: Step two: protect your heavy model quota. Switch everyday edits, searches, and quick tasks to Flash or Flash-Lite so your free limits last all day.
shots.imagePrompt: Futuristic holographic model selector dial hovering above a keyboard, switching from heavy red gauge to ultra-fast cyan Flash mode with full battery bars
shots.videoPrompt: Macro tracking shot along a glowing holographic model selector as a cursor flips to Flash mode and the quota meter stays at 100 percent emerald green

shots.title: Align First with /grill-me and /plan
shots.script: Step three: never burn tokens on trial-and-error prompts. Use slash-grill-me or slash-plan first so the agent nails your architecture in one pass.
shots.imagePrompt: 3D glowing blueprint tree branching cleanly out of a terminal command prompt reading /grill-me, dark glassmorphism UI aesthetic
shots.videoPrompt: Orbiting camera around a floating 3D blueprint decision tree unfolding smoothly above a dark terminal window as green checkmarks lock into place

shots.title: Compress Long Context with /compact
shots.script: Step four: when a conversation grows long, trigger slash-compact to summarize history and cut token consumption by up to eighty percent.
shots.imagePrompt: Long glowing stream of code scrolls compressing into a single dense glowing sapphire crystal cube inside an AI chat panel, dark sci-fi studio
shots.videoPrompt: Smooth visual metaphor shot as a tall stack of glowing chat bubbles folds and compresses neatly into a compact pulsing sapphire data crystal

shots.title: Build Zero-Dependency Local Apps
shots.script: Step five: ask Antigravity to build zero-dependency local apps using built-in OS runtimes and JSON or SQLite—zero cloud hosting bills required.
shots.imagePrompt: Sleek local server node glowing on a desktop laptop with 127.0.0.1 holographic shield, no cloud wires needed, emerald accent lighting
shots.videoPrompt: Low-angle slider shot across a developer laptop projecting a self-contained local server diagram labeled 127.0.0.1 Zero Cloud Cost in glowing emerald light

shots.title: Save Reusable Workflows with /learn
shots.script: Step six: convert repeated instructions into permanent local skills with slash-learn so you never spend quota re-explaining your setup.
shots.imagePrompt: Glowing modular skill cartridges snapping into an Antigravity tool belt hologram, labeled SKILL.md, dark neon studio
shots.videoPrompt: Crisp macro shot of a glowing digital SKILL.md cartridge sliding and locking into a futuristic dark-mode workspace dock with a soft cyan pulse

shots.title: Verify UI with the Built-In Browser Agent
shots.script: Step seven: use the built-in browser agent to test localhost UI flows directly instead of paying for external testing services.
shots.imagePrompt: Split screen holographic browser window with an automated cursor clicking checkboxes and verifying green test badges in real time
shots.videoPrompt: Dynamic pan across a floating browser viewport as an automated glowing cursor clicks through a web app and green verification badges pop up sequentially

shots.title: Extend with Free Open-Source MCP Tools
shots.script: Step eight: connect free open-source MCP servers and local CLI utilities to expand your toolkit without paid SaaS add-ons.
shots.imagePrompt: Glowing fiber-optic light bridges connecting open-source icons into a central Antigravity core, dark cinema lighting
shots.videoPrompt: Top-down crane descent over glowing cyan fiber-optic lines linking local open-source tool nodes into a central pulsing Antigravity hub

shots.title: Ship Full Projects at $0.00 Total Cost
shots.script: Plan smart, compact context, and build locally—and you can ship complete AI apps in Antigravity without spending a single penny.
shots.imagePrompt: Triumphant wide shot of a creator smiling in front of a launched web app on dual monitors with a glowing $0.00 Total Spent badge, warm rim light
shots.videoPrompt: Slow cinematic pull-back from a finished web application running on dual monitors as a crisp holographic $0.00 Spent Shipped title card resolves in center frame

projects.videoName: Echoes of the Brahmaputra - AI Cinematic Short
projects.styleSuffix: --ar 16:9, natural atmospheric lighting, 35mm anamorphic lens, rich film grain

shots.title: Pre-Dawn Mist Over River Island
shots.script: Before the first sunbeam touches Assam, the Brahmaputra breathes a silver veil across Majuli.
shots.imagePrompt: Wide aerial photography of lush river island surrounded by silver morning mist, golden horizon, 8k
shots.videoPrompt: Slow sweeping aerial drone glide low over silver morning mist rising from wide braided river channels at dawn, gentle golden light breaking on the horizon
shots.notes: Opening establishing shot - smooth aerial motion

shots.title: Bamboo Boat Crossing
shots.script: At daybreak, wooden country boats carry villagers and musicians across glassy water.
shots.imagePrompt: Traditional wooden country boat gliding through calm river mist in warm dawn light, shallow ripple reflections
shots.videoPrompt: Low water-level tracking camera moving beside a wooden country boat as a single oarsman rows gently across glassy amber morning water

shots.title: Sattriya Drum & Cymbals Close-Up
shots.script: Inside centuries-old monasteries, the rhythm of khol drums marks the morning prayer.
shots.imagePrompt: Close-up of artisan hands playing traditional Assamese khol clay drum inside warm sunlit bamboo prayer hall
shots.videoPrompt: Close-up cinematic shot of rhythmic hands striking a traditional clay khol drum while brass cymbals shimmer in dusty morning sunbeams

shots.title: Mask Maker's Workshop
shots.script: Generations of Samaguri artisans sculpt expressive bamboo and clay masks by hand.
shots.imagePrompt: Elderly master artisan painting intricate colorful mythological bamboo mask in rustic wooden workshop, warm window light
shots.videoPrompt: Gentle push-in shot on a master craftsman brushing crimson pigment onto a sculpted bamboo and clay ceremonial mask illuminated by soft window light

shots.title: Muga Silk Loom Weaving
shots.script: Golden Muga threads shimmer like spun sunlight as weavers work traditional wooden looms.
shots.imagePrompt: Macro detail of shimmering golden Muga silk threads woven on rustic handloom, warm directional sunlight
shots.videoPrompt: Macro side-tracking shot along shimmering golden Muga silk threads tensioned on a traditional wooden handloom as the shuttle glides across

shots.title: Kaziranga Tall Elephant Grass
shots.script: Further downstream, six-foot elephant grass hides one of Earth's oldest surviving giants.
shots.imagePrompt: Golden hour tall elephant grass floodplain in Assam with distant silhouette of one-horned rhino in mist
shots.videoPrompt: Slow crane rise out of swaying golden elephant grass revealing a majestic one-horned rhinoceros standing in sunlit morning wetland mist
shots.notes: Currently rendering in Kling - verify tail/ear anatomy

shots.title: Tea Garden Terraces in Rain
shots.script: When monsoon clouds roll off the eastern hills, emerald tea estates drink the rain.
shots.imagePrompt: Lush emerald green undulating tea gardens in Upper Assam under soft monsoon drizzle, moody silver sky
shots.videoPrompt: Sweeping low aerial pan across lush emerald tea garden rows swaying gently under fine silver monsoon rain and drifting hill fog

shots.title: Bamboo Bridge Over Monsoon Stream
shots.script: Every season, communities weave resilient bridges from living bamboo.
shots.imagePrompt: Hand-woven curved bamboo footbridge spanning crystal mountain stream surrounded by tropical ferns
shots.videoPrompt: Steady forward gimbal walk across a handcrafted curved bamboo footbridge above rushing emerald mountain river water and lush ferns

shots.title: Pottery Wheel & River Clay
shots.script: From the dark fertile silt left by floods, potters shape vessels without a motorized wheel.
shots.imagePrompt: Close-up of wet clay pot spinning on traditional wooden potter wheel in open courtyard, warm afternoon shadows
shots.videoPrompt: Intimate close-up of muddy artisan hands shaping a smooth terracotta vessel spinning on a hand-turned pottery wheel, water droplets gleaming

shots.title: Earthen Oil Lamps at Dusk
shots.script: As twilight settles across the valley, hundreds of earthen saki lamps awaken.
shots.imagePrompt: Rows of warm glowing terracotta oil lamps along stone steps beside calm dark river at blue hour
shots.videoPrompt: Slow pull-back shot past glowing terracotta oil lamps flickering gently along riverfront stone steps under deep cobalt twilight sky
shots.notes: Warm orange vs blue hour contrast

shots.title: Bihu Folk Dance Firelight
shots.script: Under bamboo torches, folk melodies echo the gratitude of a timeless harvest.
shots.imagePrompt: Joyful Assamese Bihu dancers in golden Muga and crimson attire framed by warm firelight bokeh at dusk
shots.videoPrompt: Medium cinematic tracking shot of graceful Bihu dancers spinning in golden Muga silk under warm bamboo torchlight, sparks drifting slowly

shots.title: Wide Starry River Reflection Finale
shots.script: From mountain snowmelt to the sea, the great river carries every song forward.
shots.imagePrompt: Epic ultra-wide night shot of calm giant river reflecting Milky Way stars and distant warm shore lanterns
shots.videoPrompt: Ultra-slow ascending crane shot over mirror-still wide river reflecting brilliant Milky Way stars and tiny warm lantern lights along the distant bank
